dedupe_keys.name: italian ten t road network and hydrogen refueling station nodes

description: Antonio De Padova and colleagues at Politecnico di Torino publish an Italian TEN-T road graph, origin-destination freight estimates and modelled hydrogen-refuelling locations. The September 2024 files are freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Nodes represent NUTS-3 centroids, fuel areas, intersections, entrances and ports; edges include road and ferry connections. CSV paths estimate tonnes and trucks in 2030. Refuelling outputs assume ten-percent hydrogen-truck uptake, specified traffic thresholds and 300–600 kilometre range limits. These inputs can test freight routing and station-placement simulations. The description mentions three shapefiles, but the inventory lists two SHP files and a station CSV, with no visible SHX or DBF companions; complete GIS usability remains uncertain. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this scenario. Neither network files nor station-placement results were downloaded or independently checked.
